title: Robustness of the triplets to the file split (three E023 splits)
question: Do the triplets beat the networks on every file split, and is their result stable across splits?
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit); rule commit: see LOG.md
eval_rule: validation and (report-only) test every max(500, steps/40) steps; selection only by validation
split_rule: grids.e023_split: the same 300 files permuted by the split seed; test 45, validation 45, train 30 (as E023)
networks: E023 results/runs_table.csv: per split the member with the best mean validation (5 seeds, 100k)

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.beats_networks: T3 + FIR7 at M = 21 beats the best E023 network of every split (min of triplets > max of network)
rule_draft.stable: spread of the T3 + FIR7 M = 21 test means across the three splits < 2 p.p.
